issues.summary: Core Order Matching Engine Latency & Throughput Optimization
issues.description: Architectural overhaul of the in-memory matching core in order-matching-engine to achieve P99 latency < 35 microseconds under 250,000 orders/second sustained throughput. Includes B-Tree index optimization, lock-free ring buffer ingestion, and NVMe write-ahead journaling.

issues.summary: Implement Lock-Free Ring Buffer Ingestion Queue (Disruptor Pattern)
issues.description: Replace Go standard channel queue in order-matching-engine with a pre-allocated 65,536-slot lock-free circular ring buffer to eliminate heap memory allocation and garbage collection pauses during high-frequency volatility spikes.

issues.summary: Implement Idempotency Middleware for Order Ingestion
issues.description: Intercept incoming order placement requests, validate client X-Idempotency-Key headers, and store execution tokens in Redis Cluster with 60-minute TTL to prevent duplicate execution during network retries.

issues.summary: Fix Race Condition on Simultaneous Partial Fill and Order Cancellation
issues.description: Resolve race condition where an order cancellation packet arriving concurrently with a partial execution match could cause an internal order state desynchronization between memory and WAL journal.

issues.summary: Real-Time Trade Settlement Ledger & Audit Log Overhaul
issues.description: Migrate settlement ledger in trade-settlement-system from single PostgreSQL transactions to an event-sourced double-entry accounting ledger consuming Kafka trades.matched topic with strict zero-sum balance invariant validation.

issues.summary: Implement Double-Entry Ledger Validation Worker in Java Spring Boot
issues.description: Build high-throughput Kafka consumer in trade-settlement-system that verifies debit/credit parity on every matched execution and records immutable postings in PostgreSQL with cryptographic sequence hashes.

issues.summary: Configure TimescaleDB Range Partitioning & Automated Columnar Compression
issues.description: Setup automated 1-day range partitioning on trade_records hyper-table and configure background job to apply columnar compression on chunks older than 7 days to reduce storage footprint by 85%.

issues.summary: Market Data Gateway Low-Latency Streaming & Protobuf Broadcast
issues.description: Overhaul market-data-gateway WebSocket streaming architecture to use Protocol Buffers v3 binary framing and Level 2 / Level 3 incremental delta diffing over Redis Cluster Pub/Sub backplane.

issues.summary: Implement L2/L3 Order Book Snapshot & Incremental Delta Broadcaster
issues.description: Broadcast 100ms incremental order book deltas with sequence numbers and provide gRPC unary endpoints for fast out-of-band snapshot resynchronization when client packet loss occurs.

issues.summary: Regulatory Compliance & Trade Surveillance Monitoring Engine
issues.description: Implement automated compliance surveillance in compliance-surveillance-monitor for real-time market abuse detection, including spoofing, layering, and wash trade anomaly identification under SEC Rule 15c3-5.

issues.summary: Implement Real-Time Spoofing & Layering Detection Pipeline
issues.description: Calculate rolling 30-second cancel-to-fill ratios per trader account and trigger automated risk flags when cancellation volume exceeds 85% of placed orders near top of book.

issues.summary: Implement Distributed Token Bucket Rate Limiting in Mini Auth Service
issues.description: Enforce tier-based rate limits (5,000 req/min Standard, 50,000 req/min VIP Institutional) using Redis sliding window log algorithm with sub-50 microsecond execution overhead.
